<function name="ScrollToChild" parent="DHorizontalScroller" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Scrolls the <page>DHorizontalScroller</page> to given child panel.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="target" type="Panel">The target child panel. Must be a child of <page>DHorizontalScroller:GetCanvas</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
